score_contract: FP32 logits(rows,32,1); original stable_scores; FP64 mean-sigmoid log odds

threshold.ties_backward: equal derivative on full threshold tie block
threshold.graph_binding: validate supplied point values and identities, recalibrate on supplied current reference_scores graph

identity_contract.normal_groups: exhaustive nonempty partition; original full denominators
identity_contract.scale_population: full identity union Q+N, each identity once
identity_contract.positive_population: full frozen P, no sampled multiplier update

scale.zero: DegenerateNormalScale; true evaluation may identify feasible zero-risk endpoint

positive_constraint.violated_signal: >=1 for every FN and threshold tie
positive_constraint.backward: continuous margin, current-reference threshold and normal-only scale graph
positive_constraint.numerical_sign_loss: error without tolerance; safe r underflow to zero explicitly rejected
positive_constraint.nextafter: detached diagnostic only, never used in updates
positive_constraint.positive_affine_claim: normal proxy and continuous normalized margins; not exact floating-point equivariance
positive_constraint.limitation: project-defined proxy/true split, not one smooth Lagrangian; no per-update feasibility or nonconvex convergence guarantee

discarded_design.reason: normal loss directly rewards reducing positive margin when active normal mean<threshold

author_reference.name: Cooper
author_reference.reuse: separate primal/dual graphs and signed residual mechanism

remaining_registration: baseline true protection state at new operating point

discarded_ulp_constraint.reason: threshold ties yield ULP-scale dual restoration, not an adequate recovery mechanism
discarded_ulp_constraint.replacement: unit strict-FN indicator minus continuous normalized margin
